attacks.name: Gamma Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Stun|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

attacks.name: Photon Blast
steps: After each attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
This character may reroll all of the attack dice for this attack.

attacks.name: Pulsar Wave
steps: Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether this attack's type is |!physical| or |!energy|.
After this attack is resolved, Place this character within |!range| 1 of its current position.
|!wild| |*Throw|: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 4 or less, this character may Throw it Away |!range_medium|.

superPowers.name: Stronger Together Than Apart (Affiliation: Mighty Avengers)
superPowers.body: Once per Turn, when an allied character would gain 1 |!power| or more, it may choose to gain 1 |!power| less. If it does, after the effect is resolved, choose an allied character. The chosen character gains 1 |!power|.

superPowers.name: Energy Boost
superPowers.body: When this character or another allied character within |!range| 4 of this character makes an attack, during the |*Create Attack Dice Pool| step, this character may use this superpower. The attacking character adds 2 dice to its attack roll. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Multi-Spectrum Energy Absorption
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against an attack, for each |!wild| in the defense roll, it may change 1 of the attacker's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!hit| results to a Blank. This character gains 1 |!power| for each die changed in this way.
